messages:
Alex R: Quick idea — short run + bouldering Friday after work? thinking 5k loop then 1 hour at Beta Boulders. low-key, all levels. :running_man:
Maria G: Love it. What time are you thinking? I can only do evenings after 6:30. :thumbsup:
Alex R: aim to meet at 6:15pm at the park entrance, run ~30min -> spots open at 7:00pm for bouldering. does that work?
Devin S: I can bring an extra chalk bag and a few crash pads if we need them. :chalk:
Tara L: Might be tight for me — could I join just for the climb? would do yoga beforehand instead.
Liam C: Beginner-friendly problems at Beta are labeled green — I can lead a quick warm-up and a couple of easy traverses.
Maria G: tagging calendar-bot to lock it in? @calendar-bot add event "Fri 6:15pm Run + Beta Boulders" 2026-04-02 18:15 -> 20:00
calendar-bot: Event created: "Fri 6:15pm Run + Beta Boulders" — invites sent to Alex R, Maria G, Devin S, Tara L, Liam C
Alex R: sweet. if anyone wants to skip the run and meet at Beta at 7:00pm that's fine too. no pressure. :seedling:
Devin S: count me in for both. I'll toss a foam roller in the trunk for post-climb stretches.
Tara L: I'll meet at 7:00 at Beta, doing a quick 30m vinyasa beforehand. see you all after. :lotus:
Liam C: perfect. also quick poll — anyone up for grabbing tacos after? :taco:
Maria G: 100% tacos.
Alex R: tacos it is. see you Friday! :raised_hands:
